fail_first_limits: Each control was run before its corresponding correction. No setup errors are counted. The native V2 no-rediscovery positive already passed; only rediscovery exposed the original-field replay defect.

exact_base_replay.boundary: An isolated process loads exact base angle gate source, base receipt schema and base V2 replay helper. Final new test methods run unchanged against those inputs; no Git worktree is modified.

partial_schema_causality.limits: Test-specific causality check, not an additional production admission defect. The original negative-only test passes for an unknown-field reason; the strengthened test detects the invalid complete positive.

frozen_qualifier_composition.limits: An isolated Python process loads only the corrected helper source into the exact frozen read-only qualifier. No frozen file, Git head, production refusal or published artifact changes. This is not the final landed-current-main second-party receipt.

partial_identity_control: A complete positive precedes deletion of repository/pin; nested ValidationError.context must contain dependentRequired. Initial assertions looked only at the root oneOf error and were corrected without changing production validation.
model_diagnostic_control: The first mixed-citation fix exposed the existing stale-model binding diagnostic test. Resolution now uses current bound typing while the diagnostic distinguishes known stale typed model evidence from an unresolved identity; no existing refusal assertion was weakened.
receipt_fixture_migration: Existing valid synthetic A1/A6 receipts now declare their own kind and candidate_id. Their original stale identity, comparative measurement and native-output assertions remain.

dispositions: Three additional existing AngleEnforcementTests receipt producers lacked the new own fields. A separate trial-metadata fixture also changes the candidate id and must update its synthetic comparison's own id. Migrated those fixture payloads only, retaining all original assertions and the entire RunTests class unchanged.

The page branch-citation test compares generated records with Git HEAD, so an uncommitted regenerated artifact cannot satisfy its immutable snapshot assertion. Final affected verification runs after an unpublished candidate commit, before any push.
initial_affected_run.limits: Fixture omissions and the dirty-generated-snapshot assertion are not counted as new production defects or fail-first controls.
